title: Lenin
plot_overview: In a village trapped by generations of bloodshed, a determined young man dares to challenge the traditions fueling an endless cycle of violence. His stand confronts the beliefs and customs that have allowed conflict to continue across generations, placing one person's courage against a deeply rooted community pattern.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like intense village dramas about breaking cycles of violence; Not for you if you prefer lighthearted stories or less confrontational themes.
review_summary: Pros: powerful central conflict; socially focused story; emotional stakes | Cons: potentially intense themes; violence-driven premise
